title: Compositional Meta-Learning for Mitigating Task Heterogeneity in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) approximate solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs) by embedding physical laws into the loss function. In parameterized PDE families, variations in coefficients or boundary/initial conditions define distinct tasks. This makes training individual PINNs for each task computationally prohibitive, while cross-task transfer can be sensitive to task heterogeneity. While meta-learning can reduce retraining cost, existing methods often rely on a single global initialization and may suffer from negative transfer, particularly under feature-scarce coordinate inputs and limited training-task availability. We propose the Learning-Affinity Adaptive Modular Physics-Informed Neural Network (LAM-PINN), a compositional framework that leverages task-specific learning dynamics. LAM-PINN combines PDE parameters with learning-affinity metrics from brief transfer sessions to construct a task representation and cluster tasks even with coordinate-only inputs. It decomposes the model into cluster-specialized subnetworks and a shared meta network, and learns routing weights to selectively reuse modules instead of relying on a single global initialization. Across three PDE benchmarks, LAM-PINN achieves an average 19.7-fold reduction in mean squared error (MSE) on unseen tasks using only 10% of the training iterations required by conventional PINNs. These results indicate its effectiveness for generalization to unseen configurations within bounded design spaces of parameterized PDE families in resource-constrained engineering settings.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于学习亲和度的自适应模块化物理信息神经网络（LAM-PINN），通过聚类任务、分解子网络和共享元网络，利用学习动态实现参数化PDE族中未见任务的高效泛化，仅需传统PINN 10%的训练轮次即可降低19.7倍MSE。
AI.motivation: 传统PINN在参数化PDE族中需为每个任务单独训练，计算成本高昂；跨任务迁移受任务异质性影响，负迁移问题严重；现有元学习方法依赖单一全局初始化，在坐标输入特征稀疏、训练任务有限时效果不佳。
AI.method: LAM-PINN将PDE参数与来自短时迁移会话的学习亲和度度量相结合，构建任务表征并对任务进行聚类；将模型分解为聚类专用子网络和共享元网络；学习路由权重以选择性重用模块，而非依赖单一全局初始化。
AI.result: 在三个PDE基准上，LAM-PINN在未见任务上平均MSE降低19.7倍，仅需传统PINN 10%的训练迭代次数。
AI.conclusion: LAM-PINN在资源受限的工程场景中，能有效泛化到参数化PDE族有界设计空间内的未见配置，显著降低计算开销。
idea_en: A modular physics-informed neural network architecture with cluster-specialized subnetworks and a shared meta network that selectively routes computations based on task-specific learning dynamics, enabling efficient generalization to unseen PDE parameter configurations.

A learning-affinity metric construction method that combines PDE parameters with brief transfer session dynamics to create task representations, enabling clustering of tasks even with coordinate-only inputs and limited training data.

A routing weight learning mechanism for selectively reusing compositional neural modules across tasks, overcoming negative transfer issues associated with single global initialization in meta-learning for PDE solving.

A task clustering approach for parameterized PDE families that uses learning dynamics from short fine-tuning sessions to group similar PDE instances, improving cross-task knowledge transfer efficiency.

A resource-efficient PINN training framework that achieves 19.7x MSE reduction using only 10% of conventional training iterations by combining modular decomposition with affinity-based task representation.
idea_ch: 一种具有聚类专用子网络和共享元网络的模块化物理信息神经网络架构，基于任务特定的学习动态选择性路由计算，实现对未见PDE参数配置的高效泛化。
一种结合PDE参数与短时迁移会话动态的学习亲和度度量构建方法，在仅含坐标输入和有限训练数据条件下创建任务表征并实现任务聚类。
一种路由权重学习机制，用于跨任务选择性重用组合神经模块，克服元学习在PDE求解中依赖单一全局初始化导致的负迁移问题。
一种参数化PDE族的任务聚类方法，利用短时微调会话中的学习动态对相似PDE实例分组，提升跨任务知识迁移效率。
一种资源高效的PINN训练框架，通过模块化分解与基于亲和度的任务表征相结合，仅用传统PINN 10%的训练迭代次数即可实现19.7倍的MSE降低。

title: Binary Spiking Neural Networks as Causal Models
summary: We provide a causal analysis of Binary Spiking Neural Networks (BSNNs) to explain their behavior. We formally define a BSNN and represent its spiking activity as a binary causal model. Thanks to this causal representation, we are able to explain the output of the network by leveraging logic-based methods. In particular, we show that we can successfully use a SAT as well as a SMT solver to compute abductive explanations from this binary causal model. To illustrate our approach, we trained the BSNN on the standard MNIST dataset and applied our SAT-based and SMT-based methods to finding abductive explanations of the network's classifications based on pixel-level features. We also compared the found explanations against SHAP, a popular method used in the area of explainable AI. We show that, unlike SHAP, our approach guarantees that a found explanation does not contain completely irrelevant features.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因果分析和逻辑推理的方法，用于解释二元脉冲神经网络（BSNN）的行为。通过将BSNN的脉冲活动表示为二元因果模型，利用SAT和SMT求解器计算反事实解释，确保解释中不包含不相关的特征。
AI.motivation: BSNN作为第三代神经网络，其行为难以解释。现有解释方法（如SHAP）可能包含不相关特征，缺乏因果保证。因此需要一种能够提供严格因果解释的方法。
AI.method: 1. 将BSNN的脉冲活动形式化为二元因果模型；2. 利用SAT/SMT求解器从该因果模型中计算反事实解释；3. 在MNIST数据集上训练BSNN并验证方法有效性；4. 与SHAP方法进行对比分析。
AI.result: 该方法能够成功生成反事实解释，且与SHAP相比，保证解释中不包含完全不相关的特征，提供了更强的因果解释能力。
AI.conclusion: 基于逻辑求解器的因果解释方法优于SHAP等黑盒解释方法，能提供无冗余特征的精确解释，为脉冲神经网络的可解释性提供了新途径。
idea_en: A method for generating abductive explanations for Binary Spiking Neural Networks by formalizing spiking activity as a binary causal model and using SAT/SMT solvers to compute explanations.
A technique for ensuring that explanations of spiking neural network outputs contain no irrelevant features by leveraging logic-based causal reasoning instead of statistical methods like SHAP.
A system that converts the temporal spiking behavior of BSNNs into a static binary causal representation suitable for logical analysis and explanation generation.
An approach combining causal modeling with SAT/SMT solving to provide guaranteed minimal explanations for neuromorphic computing systems.
idea_ch: 一种将二元脉冲神经网络的脉冲活动形式化为二元因果模型，并利用SAT/SMT求解器计算反事实解释的方法。
一种基于逻辑因果推理而非统计方法（如SHAP）来确保脉冲神经网络输出解释中不包含任何不相关特征的技术。
一种将BSNN的时序脉冲行为转换为静态二元因果表示，以便进行逻辑分析和解释生成的系统。
一种结合因果建模与SAT/SMT求解器，为神经形态计算系统提供有保障的最小化解释的方法。

title: When Your LLM Reaches End-of-Life: A Framework for Confident Model Migration in Production Systems
summary: We present a framework for migrating production Large Language Model (LLM) based systems when the underlying model reaches end-of-life or requires replacement. The key contribution is a Bayesian statistical approach that calibrates automated evaluation metrics against human judgments, enabling confident model comparison even with limited manual evaluation data. We demonstrate this framework on a commercial question-answering system serving 5.3M monthly interactions across six global regions; evaluating correctness, refusal behavior, and stylistic adherence to successfully identify suitable replacement models. The framework is broadly applicable to any enterprise deploying LLM-based products, providing a principled, reproducible methodology for model migration that balances quality assurance with evaluation efficiency. This is a capability increasingly essential as the LLM ecosystem continues to evolve rapidly and organizations manage portfolios of AI-powered services across multiple models, regions, and use cases.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于贝叶斯统计的框架，用于在底层LLM达到生命周期终点或需要替换时，对生产环境中的LLM系统进行迁移。该框架将自动评估指标与人工判断进行校准，在有限人工评估数据下实现可靠的模型比较。
AI.motivation: LLM生态快速演进，底层模型频繁达到生命周期终点或需要替换，但缺乏一种系统化、可复现的方法来评估和选择替代模型，尤其是在人工评估数据有限的情况下。
AI.method: 提出贝叶斯统计方法，将自动化评估指标与人工判断进行校准，使模型间比较在仅依赖有限人工评估数据时仍具有较高置信度。框架评估了正确性、拒绝行为和风格一致性三个维度。
AI.result: 在每月服务530万次交互、覆盖六个全球区域的商业问答系统中成功验证，能够有效识别合适的替代模型，在保证质量的同时提高评估效率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架具有广泛适用性，为部署LLM产品的企业提供了一种原则性、可复现的模型迁移方法论，在快速演变的LLM生态中平衡质量保证与评估效率。
idea_en: A Bayesian calibration method that aligns automated evaluation metrics with human judgments for reliable LLM model comparison in production environments
Multi-dimensional evaluation framework (correctness, refusal behavior, stylistic adherence) for systematic LLM migration decision-making
Confidence-weighted model selection system using limited manual evaluation data augmented by calibrated automated metrics
idea_ch: 一种贝叶斯校准方法，将自动化评估指标与人工判断对齐，实现生产环境中LLM模型的可靠比较
基于多维度评估（正确性、拒绝行为、风格一致性）的系统化LLM迁移决策框架
利用有限人工评估数据结合校准后的自动化指标进行置信度加权的模型选择系统

title: End-to-end autonomous scientific discovery on a real optical platform
summary: Scientific research has long been human-led, driving new knowledge and transformative technologies through the continual revision of questions, methods and claims as evidence accumulates. Although large language model (LLM)-based agents are beginning to move beyond assisting predefined research workflows, none has yet demonstrated end-to-end autonomous discovery in a real physical system that produces a nontrivial result supported by experimental evidence. Here we introduce Qiushi Discovery Engine, an LLM-based agentic system for end-to-end autonomous scientific discovery on a real optical platform. Qiushi Engine combines nonlinear research phases, Meta-Trace memory and a dual-layer architecture to maintain adaptive and stable research trajectories across long-horizon investigations involving thousands of LLM-mediated reasoning, measurement and revision actions. It autonomously reproduces a published transmission-matrix experiment on a non-original platform and converts an abstract coherence-order theory into experimental observables, providing, to our knowledge, the first observation of this class of coherence-order structure. More importantly, in an open-ended study involving 145.9 million tokens, 3,242 LLM calls, 1,242 tool calls, 163 research notes and 44 scripts, Qiushi Engine proposes and experimentally validates optical bilinear interaction, a physical mechanism structurally analogous to a core operation in Transformer attention. This AI-discovered mechanism suggests a route towards high-speed, energy-efficient optical hardware for pairwise computation. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of an AI agentic system autonomously identifying and experimentally validating a nontrivial, previously unreported physical mechanism, marking a milestone for research-level autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了"秋实发现引擎"(Qiushi Discovery Engine)，一个基于LLM的自主科学发现智能体系统。该系统能够在真实光学平台上实现端到端的自主科学发现，包括自主复现已发表的实验、将抽象理论转化为实验观测，并首次自主发现并实验验证了一种新的物理机制——光学双线性相互作用，该机制在结构上类似于Transformer注意力机制的核心操作。
AI.motivation: 虽然LLM智能体已开始辅助预定义的研究工作流，但尚无系统能在真实物理系统中实现端到端的自主科学发现，并产生由实验证据支持的非平凡结果。
AI.method: 提出Qiushi Discovery Engine，结合非线性研究阶段(非线性研究阶段)、Meta-Trace记忆(元轨迹记忆)和双层架构(双层次架构)，在涉及数千次LLM推理、测量和修正动作的长周期探索中保持自适应且稳定的研究轨迹。
AI.result: 1) 在非原始平台上自主复现已发表的传输矩阵实验；2) 将抽象的相干阶理论转化为实验可观测量，首次观测到该类相干阶结构；3) 在涉及1.459亿token、3242次LLM调用、1242次工具调用、163份研究笔记和44个脚本的开放研究中，自主提出并实验验证了光学双线性相互作用这一新物理机制。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个能够自主识别并实验验证先前未报道的非平凡物理机制的AI智能体系统，标志着研究级自主智能体的里程碑。该AI发现的机制为高速、节能的光学对计算硬件提供了新路径。
idea_en: A dual-layer architecture for LLM-based scientific discovery agents that separates high-level research planning from low-level experiment execution, enabling stable long-horizon autonomous investigation.
Meta-Trace memory system that maintains adaptive research trajectories across thousands of LLM-mediated reasoning, measurement and revision actions in open-ended scientific discovery.
Nonlinear research phase methodology for LLM agents that allows iterative revision of questions, methods and claims during autonomous scientific investigation.
Method for converting abstract coherence-order theory into experimental observables using LLM-based agents, enabling automated theory-to-experiment translation.
Optical bilinear interaction mechanism that structurally mimics the core operation of Transformer attention, discovered autonomously by an AI system and experimentally validated.

End-to-end autonomous scientific discovery system operating on real optical platforms that can reproduce published experiments, propose novel physical mechanisms, and design experimental verification protocols.
LLM-based agent system for autonomous transmission-matrix experiment reproduction on non-original optical platforms without human intervention.
Method for long-context scientific reasoning across 145.9 million tokens using hierarchical memory and planning to maintain coherent research trajectories.
idea_ch: 一种用于基于LLM的科学发现智能体的双层架构，将高层研究规划与底层实验执行分离，实现了稳定的长期自主研究。
元轨迹记忆(Meta-Trace memory)系统，能够在开放科学发现过程中，跨数千次LLM推理、测量和修正动作维持自适应的研究轨迹。
用于LLM智能体的非线性研究阶段方法，允许在自主科学研究过程中迭代修正问题、方法和结论。
利用基于LLM的智能体将抽象相干阶理论转化为实验可观测量的方法，实现了从理论到实验的自动化转换。
光学双线性相互作用机制，其在结构上模仿了Transformer注意力的核心操作，由AI系统自主发现并经过实验验证。
运行在真实光学平台上的端到端自主科学发现系统，能够复现已发表实验、提出新物理机制并设计实验验证方案。
基于LLM的智能体系统，可在非原始光学平台上自主复现传输矩阵实验，无需人工干预。
利用分层记忆和规划在1.459亿token长上下文中进行科学推理的方法，以维持连贯的研究轨迹。
